quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: co-founder and vice president Zhang Yubo said Lushan-related GPU products are expected to launch within the year (the company's pre-collected answer: expected at end-2026). Chairman Zhang Jianzhong said that in H1 2026 the company brought in leading internet companies and telecom operators as customers; that MTT S5000 passed the national security and reliability evaluation; and that supply chain and capacity match business needs. Board secretary and CFO Xue Yansong said H1 gross profit was RMB 9.89 hundred million, up 103.78%, and recurring net loss RMB -1.51 hundred million, narrowed 52.37%; Zhang Yubo attributed the 56.95% H1 gross margin to rising semiconductor raw-material prices and delivery mix.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 gross profit RMB 9.89 hundred million (+103.78%); recurring net loss RMB -1.51 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Moore Threads results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: co-founder Zhou Yuan said H1 R&D investment was RMB 7.69 hundred million, up 38.16%, with 1,019 R&D staff, focused on the Huagang-architecture Huashan and Lushan chips; MUSA developers now exceed 80 ten-thousand and SGLang has merged MUSA support into its main line. Zhang Yubo said a prefill-decode disaggregated inference solution built with partners on MTT S5000 prefill pools matches international flagship GPUs on cost-performance and is moving to production deployment. Chairman Zhang Jianzhong said the MTT C256 supernode architecture links up to 256 cards in a single-layer scale-up network with sub-microsecond card-to-card latency and liquid cooling.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 R&D RMB 7.69 hundred million (+38.16%); MUSA developers over 80 ten-thousand
